changes.evidence: Runaways S2: after Jonah's death Leslie sets out to shut the Church of Gibborim down ('Hostile Takeover'); Frank and the adepts turn on her, recondition her and imprison her in the Crater until Karolina rescues her, after which she shelters with the Runaways at the Hostel. Runaways S3: she returns to the Church, finds it popular after Karolina's 'Radiance', and decides to rebuild it instead of destroying it. Her break with the church in S2 and her return in S3 are not recorded.

Runaways S3 episode 4 (RW304): after Elle is born, Xavin disguises themself as Victor Stein to take the baby from the Magistrate's Son, then boards the Magistrates' ship and leaves Earth with Elle as her new mother. Xavin does not return, so they leave the Runaways in S3.

Cloak & Dagger S2 episode 3 (CD203): Delgado quits St. Sebastian's and stops working as a priest. S2 episode 10 (CD210): following Tyrone's note, he takes over the run-down St. Theresa's Church where Tyrone had hidden, and starts rebuilding it to become a priest again. His return to the priesthood is not recorded (the record's own step says he 'returns to the priesthood and takes over Tandy's old church').

owner_calls.question: At the end of Runaways S2, Karolina is captured by Jonah (the Magistrate, in Victor's body) and held in his healing algorithm until she escapes early in S3. Should that capture and her return to the Runaways be recorded as stages?
options: Keep as is (Church of Gibborim -> Runaways)
Add a held-captive stage at Runaways S1–S2 and ['The Runaways', 'Runaways S3'] after it
owner_calls.evidence: RW213: Victor/Jonah blasts Janet, Chase and Karolina into the Healing Algorithm; RW302: they break out of the algorithm and return to the Hostel. The record's own S2 step has status 'Imprisoned'.

owner_calls.question: Chase is captured with Karolina and Janet by Jonah (in Victor's body) at the end of S2 and held in the healing algorithm until early S3. Should the capture be a stage between 'The Pride' and 'The Runaways' (Runaways S3)?
options: Add a held-captive stage at Runaways S1–S2 before ['The Runaways', 'Runaways S3']
owner_calls.evidence: RW213 ('Captured by Magistrate'): Chase is put into the Healing Algorithm. In S3 he escapes, and the Runaways agree to take him back. The record's S2 step has status 'Imprisoned'.

owner_calls.question: Tyrone is a student and basketball player at St. Sebastian's Preparatory School through Cloak & Dagger S1 and leaves it when he is framed for Fuchs's murder and goes on the run (S1 ep 9-10). The record has 'Independent (from the start)'. Should the school be a stage he leaves, as it is in Father Delgado's record?
owner_calls.evidence: MCU wiki: 'Tyrone Johnson is a former student at the St. Sebastian's Preparatory School and a former player of its basketball team'. He flees home when NOPD come to arrest him (CD109) and stays a fugitive through S2.
